decisions.reason: The resistor-placement decision does not change any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment or the available GPIO pool.
Placing the I2C series resistors at the ESP32-S3 pins does not change the interboard signal connector, pinout, or signal set.
The I2C series-resistor position does not affect the separate interboard power connector or its pin-order rule.
The source decision concerns I2C signal conditioning and does not alter the USB data interface.
The I2C resistor topology does not change standalone USB power activation, regulation, source selection, or powered loads.
The component-placement detail does not change the three-board architecture or the roles of the main and sensor boards.
The source decision concerns SDA/SCL series resistors, not the switched 5V rail, its enable GPIO, or its loads.
The I2C series-resistor placement does not alter LED power, level shifting, data signaling, or shutdown behavior.
The sensor board remains a connector hub; locating I2C damping resistors at the ESP32-S3 pins does not change that role.
The I2C resistor decision is unrelated to the charge-status LED circuit, connector, and resistor configuration.
The source decision does not change the PMIC, required rails, normal-operation source, or battery power path.
The I2C series-resistor position does not affect DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or its normal-operation role.
